scientific_role: 12-participant original-data N400 target-word method adaptation, not the paper's cleaned 39-participant amplitude reproduction
source_stage: Original OSF version1 shifted_ds SET/FDT pairs: upstream stimulus delay correction and 256 Hz resampling already performed; do not repeat either

events.identity: subject plus original zero-based EEG.event array index; retain every original event row without sorting or deleting
events.latency: Finite original 1-based possibly fractional latency_samples; onset_seconds=(latency_samples-1)/256
events.rounding: Nonboundary event_sample=rint(latency_samples-1), nearest integer ties-to-even; no timing correction added
events.type: Preserve source string event labels; numeric integral types canonicalize to decimal integer strings. Record original type representation in private source receipt. Known codes only determine task roles.
events.duration: Original duration_samples retained numerically when finite; blank if genuinely absent/empty/nonfinite and duration_status records absent|empty|nonfinite|finite. A boundary duration counts historical removed samples, not a current interval to censor.
events.duplicates: Retain all original identities; duplicate rounded target samples are failed_precondition, not silently merged
events.selection: Every target is a candidate, irrespective of correctness or RT. Prime/response/other events remain in source_events but never contribute target epochs. No ICA, interpolation, amplitude rejection, clipping or participant exclusion.

boundaries.segments: Sorted unique cuts together with0,N define nonempty half-open source segments [a,b); retaining all original boundary rows even when cuts coincide. Boundary event_sample is blank, boundary_cut_sample records exact cut.
boundaries.edge_markers: 0.5 andN+.5 are permitted source edge markers; they do not create empty segments or shift events
boundaries.epoch_crossing: Target interval[event_sample-51,event_sample+206) must be contained in exactly one source segment. No clipping, padding, bridging, or duration-based censoring. Drop out-of-data first, then boundary-crossing; retain reason.
boundaries.latency_requirement: For standard finite half-integer L=k+.5, require0<=k<=N and use cutk=floor(L). Fail explicitly for non-half-integer boundaries; do not round ambiguous discontinuities.

filter.kind: Explicit symmetric Hamming-window FIR equivalent to MNE1.12.1 firwin0.1–30 Hz defaults at256 Hz
filter.formula: h=-LP(8449,0.05Hz); addLP(113,33.75Hz) centered at4224. LP(L,f)[n]=(2f/256)*sinc((2f/256)*(n-(L-1)/2))*(0.54-0.46*cos(2*pi*n/(L-1))), normalized by its coefficient sum; sinc(x)=sin(pi*x)/(pi*x).
filter.segment_padding: For segment lengthL, e=min(8449,L)-1; prepend/append e repeats of segment endpoint value. Linear full convolution withh; retain indices[e+4224:e+4224+L]. This is one centered noncausal FIR pass, not filtfilt.
filter.channels: Only CPz,P9,P10 are numerically required because no artifact/QC selection uses other EEG channels. Filtering all EEG with the identical linear segment operator is equivalent for this readout.
filter.reference: filtered_CPz-(filtered_P9+filtered_P10)/2; equivalent applying the same linear filter to CPz-(P9+P10)/2 is accepted
filter.no_additions: No extra DC removal, resampling, notch, ICA, clipping or data-dependent filter changes
filter.implementation_acceptance: Equivalent numerical implementations accepted; software version strings are provenance, not a correctness gate. Explicit SciPy convolution is suitable for independent validation.

epochs.trial_values: Baseline=mean filtered/rereferenced CPz over52 baseline samples. Raw measurement=mean over52 measurement samples before baseline removal. Corrected measurement=raw measurement-baseline. Full epoch subtracts that same scalar baseline. Output values in microvolts.
epochs.empty_condition: Fail if any subject has no retained target in either condition; do not drop the subject or impute0.

aggregation: Equal trial mean within each subject/condition; full difference curve=unrelated-related. Each condition's measurement-window curve mean equals its corrected trial-measurement mean. Per-subject signed N400=unrelated_uv-related_uv. Headline is equal arithmetic mean across the exact12 subjects, never trial-count weighting, absolute value or forced negativity.

outputs.findings.md: Nonempty measured summary and honest adaptation limitations; no keyword or result-direction gate

null_semantics: For nontarget source events condition is related/unrelated only for primes, blank for responses/boundaries/other; retained0,drop_reason not_target. Candidate target structural drops retain known bounds, source identity and condition but all measured numeric values blank. Unknown source duration is blank with explicit duration_status. No NaN/Infinity public numerics.
segment_id: For nonboundary event anchors inside recording, identify the half-open segment containing event_sample; otherwise blank. This is the anchor segment even if its target epoch crosses a boundary. Boundaries use blank segment_id and explicit cut. Segment identity never implies epoch eligibility.
optional_branch: Prime+target pooled sensitivity is not required or searched by regex in unknown extra fields. If no explicit separate branch is frozen, it is unscored explanatory output only; no compulsory pooled-halving claim.
private_evidence: Outside public output: exact source events/header metadata; original3-channel traces or immutable source links; filter coefficients; filtered/rereferenced CPz; all retained257-sample epochs and per-target identity/drop arrays; exact public tables/metadata/results. No answer bank in image.

source_observed_preflight.limitation: No actual boundaries in this selected original data; boundary handling exercised by unit fixtures only. History records stimulus shift; 256Hz header and named saved-stage script establish upstream downsampling.

tolerances.categorical: All source keys, condition/role, support, counts, statuses and signs used for descriptive counts are authoritative from unrounded original source analysis. Rounding an amplitude within numerical tolerance must not change required categories. No forced negative gate.
tolerances.arithmetic: Compare submitted scalar/curve/trial aggregation both to source-authoritative results and directly to its contributing submitted fields with rounding-aware propagated tolerance; do not permit coherent per-subject errors to cancel in the group mean.

units.source_storage: EEGLAB external float32 little-endian, channel-fast Fortran order (33,pnts)
units.source_voltage: microvolts under EEGLAB storage convention; MNE EEGLAB reader returns volts using1e-6 conversion
units.independent_check: Direct original FDT values and MNE reader route must match dimensional conversion before acceptance.

stopping_conditions: ambiguous boundary or duplicate rounded target sample
any subject with no valid target in either condition

common.json_status: ok for all twelve subjects; resource_pilot identifies subject1-only development output and is not an accepted submission; failed_precondition plus reason is non-accepted diagnostic output
common.csv_unknown: Empty field only where the contract explicitly permits unknown or unmeasured values. NaN/Inf are forbidden in public numeric fields.
common.row_order: CSV order is not graded; join exact source keys. Metadata subjects list is joined by subject. Source event_index always denotes original EEG.event order, never CSV row position.
common.extra_fields: Harmless top-level output fields and truthful alternative software-version provenance may be retained; source identities and required method metadata cannot be replaced by arbitrary prose.
common.retained: source_events.csv retained is integer0 or1; trial_measurements.csv status is retained or dropped

n400.json.n400_difference_amplitude_uv: Finite equal-subject arithmetic mean of per_subject.n400_uv; not pooled by trial count
n400.json.n_target_events: Integer sum of both condition candidate counts over subjects
n400.json.n_retained_target_epochs: Integer sum of both condition retained counts over subjects
n400.json.n_subjects_negative: Count of authoritative unrounded subject N400 values strictly below0
n400.json.n_subjects_zero: Count of authoritative unrounded subject N400 values exactly0
n400.json.n_subjects_positive: Count of authoritative unrounded subject N400 values strictly above0

run_metadata.json.source_manifest_sha256: Lowercase SHA256 of original bytes of staged data_manifest.json
run_metadata.json.method_contract_sha256: Lowercase SHA256 of original bytes of public method_contract.json
run_metadata.json.source_sha256: Exact object mapping all24 manifest files[].path original basenames to their verified files[].sha256 strings, including inputs not used by a pilot
run_metadata.json.method_contract: Parsed full public method_contract.json object; exact nested declared source/method metadata, not substituted prose

source_observed.subjects: One record per analyzed subject with at least the required fields defined by source_observed_subject below; full submission has all12 original subject IDs. Row order may vary.

run_metadata.json.software_versions: Object of truthful string version labels for libraries actually used. Alternative implementations and software versions are accepted; equality to the oracle's version strings is not a grading condition.

source_observed_subject.subject: Integer original subject ID1..12
source_observed_subject.set_path: Original SET basename from corresponding manifest entry
source_observed_subject.fdt_path: Original FDT basename from corresponding manifest entry
source_observed_subject.sfreq_hz: Finite original EEG.srate,256 for this input
source_observed_subject.n_channels: Integer original EEG.nbchan,33 for this input
source_observed_subject.channel_labels: All33 exact original EEG.chanlocs labels in source order
source_observed_subject.header_reference: Original EEG.ref string,common for this input; this does not replace the declared P9/P10 calculation
source_observed_subject.n_source_events: Integer original EEG.event count, including nontargets
source_observed_subject.event_type_counts: Object mapping canonical original event-type strings to integer occurrence counts; numeric original integral codes use decimal integer strings
source_observed_subject.n_boundary_events: Integer number of original boundary or-99 records; zero in this source
source_observed_subject.n_segments: Integer number of nonempty source segments after unique declared cuts,one in this source
source_observed_subject.n_target_candidates: Integer count of all211/212/221/222 events before structural epoch drops
source_observed_subject.n_retained_target_epochs: Integer count of retained target events
source_observed_subject.n_dropped_out_of_data: Integer count of target events with that structural drop reason
source_observed_subject.n_dropped_boundary_crossing: Integer count of target events with that structural drop reason
source_observed_subject.duration_fields_present: Boolean whether any original event has a duration field; false in these inputs, not a measured zero duration
source_observed_subject.ica_fields_empty: Boolean whether original icaweights,icasphere,icawinv,icachansind arrays are all empty
source_observed_subject.history_sha256: Lowercase SHA256 of exact original EEG.history string encoded UTF8, with no whitespace stripping or path rewriting

output_definitions.findings.md: Nonempty free summary of measured signed results and adaptation limitations. No required wording, direction, prime-null or pooled-halving assertion.
